text: Brooklyn Loft venue policy. Maximum occupancy is 40 guests. Decorations must use removable fasteners and exits must remain clear.
Brooklyn Loft allows outside food only from licensed caterers. Birthday cake may be brought by the host.
Brooklyn Loft provides step-free wheelchair access and an accessible restroom. Contact staff in advance for seating layout assistance.
Older Brooklyn Loft accessibility note: side entrance has two steps and restroom accessibility is not specified.
Brooklyn Loft cancellations made at least 14 days before the event receive a full deposit refund. Later cancellations forfeit the deposit.
Outdated Brooklyn Loft terms required 30 days notice for any deposit refund.

Family Table peanut and tree nut allergen policy: foods containing peanuts and tree nuts are prepared in a shared kitchen. The caterer cannot guarantee an allergen-free meal and requests allergy details before booking.
Previous Family Table policy stated peanut-free orders could be prepared on request, but cross-contact controls were not described.
Family Table offers gluten-free menu selections, but food is prepared in a shared kitchen and is not certified free from gluten cross-contact.
Family Table menu includes vegan entree and dessert options when requested at least seven days in advance.
Family Table catering orders may be cancelled without charge up to seven days before service.
Craft Party requires one supervising adult for every five children under age 12. Supervising adults must remain in the activity room.
Craft Party uses child-safe scissors and washable materials. Children must follow instructor directions and closed-toe shoes are recommended.
Draft safety update: additional allergy precautions may apply. Contact the activity provider for details.
Craft Party tables can accommodate wheelchair seating when the provider is notified before the event.
Trampoline Zone requires one adult supervisor for every eight participating children.
Trampoline Zone requires grip socks, signed waivers, and compliance with posted jumping rules. Participants with relevant medical restrictions should not jump without clinician clearance.
Old Trampoline Zone guidance permitted bare feet and did not mention grip socks.
Queens Celebrations operates a dedicated peanut-free preparation room and publishes separate tree-nut handling procedures.
Queens Hall does not allow outside food except a commercially packaged birthday cake.
Brooklyn Loft temporary operations notice states the accessible restroom may be unavailable during renovation; guests should contact the venue before booking.
